notes.title: Mac / Linux versions
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We just released the Windows version of the game but we want to say to the Mac / Linux users that we haven't forgetten you.

For our next big update we will focus on Mac / Linux versions of the game and some new contents, so stay tuned ;)

See you soon!
